questions.question: Electrolysis is the process in which:
options: Electrical energy drives a non-spontaneous redox reaction

questions.question: In BOTH galvanic and electrolytic cells, the anode is always:
In an electrolytic cell, the polarity of the anode is:
options: Positive — it is wired to the positive terminal of the power source

questions.question: During electrolysis, the cations in the electrolyte move toward:
options: The cathode, where they are reduced

questions.question: Carbon electrodes are used for the electrolysis of copper chloride solution because carbon is:
options: Inert — it conducts but takes no part in the reaction

questions.question: The half-reaction at the cathode during electrolysis of CuCl₂ solution is:
The observation at the anode during electrolysis of CuCl₂ solution is:
options: Bubbles of chlorine gas with a sharp smell

questions.question: The blue-green colour of the solution fades during the electrolysis because:
options: Copper ions are steadily removed from solution as they plate onto the cathode
The carbon electrodes bleach the water

questions.question: To silver-plate a spoon, the correct setup is:
options: Spoon as anode, silver bar as cathode, any salt solution
Spoon as cathode, silver bar as anode, silver nitrate solution as electrolyte
Two silver bars with the spoon in between
Spoon as cathode, copper bar as anode, copper sulfate solution

questions.question: During silver plating, the concentration of silver ions in the electrolyte:
options: Stays constant — the dissolving anode replaces exactly what the cathode deposits

questions.question: Two common reasons for electroplating an object are:
options: Increasing its mass, and its magnetism
Making it conduct, and making it flexible

questions.question: In the electrolytic refining of copper, the impure copper slab serves as:
options: The cathode, where pure copper collects
The anode, which dissolves while precious-metal impurities fall off as sludge

questions.question: The three products of the electrolysis of concentrated NaCl solution are:
options: Chlorine at the anode, hydrogen at the cathode, and sodium hydroxide in solution

questions.question: Sodium metal does NOT form at the cathode because:
options: There are no sodium ions in the solution
Sodium is a gas at room temperature
Sodium ions are extremely hard to reduce, so water is reduced instead

questions.question: The cathode half-reaction in brine electrolysis is:
The brine must be CONCENTRATED because in dilute solution:
options: Water out-competes chloride at the anode and oxygen forms instead of chlorine

questions.question: In the hill picture, an electrolytic cell is:
options: Water flowing downhill on its own
A pump forcing water uphill — a reaction driven by purchased energy

questions.question: A rechargeable battery being charged is operating as:
options: An electrolytic cell — the wall socket forces the reaction backwards

questions.question: When plus and minus labels confuse you, the reliable way to find the anode is to ask:
options: Where oxidation — the removal of electrons — is happening

subtopics.title: A Silver Skin on a Steel Spoon

questions.question: In electroplating, the object to be coated is connected as:
options: The cathode — the negative electrode, where metal ions deposit

questions.question: The bar of plating metal at the positive electrode acts as:
options: Both paint tin and refill — it dissolves to keep the bath supplied with ions

questions.question: Electroplating coats crevices no brush could reach because:
options: The current heats the metal until it flows
The coating is sprayed under pressure
Ions deposit atom by atom wherever the electrode surface touches the solution
The object is spun at high speed

questions.question: In copper refining, the anode sludge is valuable because it contains:
options: Precious metals like silver, gold and platinum that never dissolved

subtopics.title: Salt Water In, Three Industries Out

questions.question: The chlor-alkali industry's one cheap input is:
The sodium hydroxide left in the tank forms from:
options: The remaining sodium ions and the hydroxide ions left behind when water is reduced

questions.question: A major use of the chlorine produced is:
options: Purifying drinking water and making PVC

questions.question: Household products that trace back to brine electrolysis include:
options: Pool chlorine, soap and plastic piping
